rationale: Re-reviewed compiler-convert across three changes. Export runtime (R8 slice 2): compiler/index.ts and sandbox-route.ts carry the render's runtime data beside the CSS. Hard-link follow-up: claimTargets and the engine-result check refuse a hard-linked .jess path (nlink > 1). Script-sandbox settings: compiler/src/config.ts sends only the settings knownSettings defines and decodes a chain above a read root only when a file first needs it (prepareConfigsFor); compiler/src/index.ts shares loadsConfig between sourceOptions and the sandbox's prepareSource hook. convert-to-jess.ts is unchanged: the projection still comes only from context.pluginOf(document)?.jessFunctions?.() and passes unchanged to emitJess, no projection is built in the consumer, the owner is not imported, and the alternatives' anchor lines are unchanged.
